name: Tencent Cloud COS
description: Upload photos to Tencent Cloud Object Storage (COS).

zh.title: 地域
zh.description: 存储桶所在地域，例如 ap-shanghai、ap-beijing、ap-guangzhou。

en.title: Region
en.description: The bucket region, for example ap-shanghai, ap-beijing, or ap-guangzhou.

zh.title: 存储桶
zh.description: 完整存储桶名称，必须带 APPID 后缀，例如 my-photos-1250000000。

en.title: Bucket
en.description: The full bucket name including the APPID suffix, for example my-photos-1250000000.

zh.title: 服务端点
zh.description: 可选。留空使用默认域名 <bucket>.cos.<region>.myqcloud.com；使用私有化或专属域名时填写。

en.title: Endpoint
en.description: Optional. Leave empty for the default <bucket>.cos.<region>.myqcloud.com host; set it for private or dedicated domains.

zh.title: 基础路径
zh.description: 可选。所有照片对象都会写入此前缀目录。

en.title: Base path
en.description: Optional prefix for all uploaded photo objects.

zh.title: 公开访问地址
zh.description: 可选。填写 CDN 加速域名或公开读的存储桶域名；留空则使用端点地址。

en.title: Public URL prefix
en.description: Optional CDN or public-read bucket domain. Leave empty to use the endpoint.

zh.title: 访问地址模式（public/signed）
zh.description: 存储桶公开读时使用 public；私有读使用 signed。

en.title: URL mode (public/signed)
en.description: Use public for public-read buckets; use signed for private buckets.

zh.title: 签名地址有效期（秒）
zh.description: 仅 signed 模式生效，范围 60–86400，默认 900。

en.title: Signed URL lifetime (seconds)
en.description: Only for signed mode. Allowed range is 60–86400; default is 900.
